title: Neon Night-Market Courier
premise: A long urban drama on a neon rainy night. Red-raincoat courier Lin and rival Abao are easily confused; the wax-sealed wooden box goes intact→pried open→empty; the old motorcycle is wrecked in a crash and must be avoided; apprentice Aning returns after a long absence to take over; count memory (wax seals / lanterns / brass padlocks), false friends, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.
_comment: Author layer: humans only write entities + state machines + per-scene timelines (present + handwritten action + semantic events). op/gap/probe/forbidden are derived by complete_gt.py.

states.alert_youth: A woman courier in her twenties, short hair, bright-red hooded raincoat, a black waterproof mail bag on her left shoulder, alert eyes.
states.weary_injured: The same woman courier looking weary: short hair plastered wet to her forehead, a tear in the red raincoat, left arm wrapped in a makeshift bandage, still carrying the black mail bag.
states.retired_away: Courier Lin has withdrawn and left; only an empty red raincoat hangs on a chair back—she herself no longer appears.

states.young_runner: Young Aning: a lean night-market runner girl of fifteen or sixteen, dark-blue rain cape, brim pulled low, stubborn eyes.
states.adult_successor: Adult Aning: a tall upright woman courier in her early twenties, still in a dark-blue rain cape, eyes steady and firm.

states.sealed_intact: A palm-sized dark wooden box, lid pressed with a dark-red wax seal, copper corners on all four edges.
states.pried_open: The wax-sealed wooden box has been pried open; the dark-red wax seal is cracked and peeling, the lid forced up, copper corners askew.
states.empty_sealed: The wooden box lid was flung open then hastily bound with cord; the inside is empty, wax crumbs stuck to the rim; thereafter shown only as an empty box.

states.intact: An oilcloth-covered delivery ledger, carbon paper clipped inside, filled with neon alley names and signature columns.
states.rain_blurred: The same delivery ledger soaked by rain: cover wrinkled, ink bled into purple-black stains.

states.intact: A dark-red old motorcycle, faded 'Lin' sticker on the tank, a waterproof mail-bag rack strapped to the rear seat.
states.wrecked: The dark-red old motorcycle has been sideswiped and toppled by a truck; tank dented, wheels twisted—an unridable wreck.

states.young_rival: A male courier rival of build close to Lin's, same bright-red hooded raincoat, a scar on his chin, a silver ring on his right hand, defiant look.
states.remade_return: Adult Abao still wears the red raincoat; the chin scar deeper, the silver ring swapped for a black iron ring, expression dark.

E7.name: night-market stall
E7.appearance: A wet night-market food stall under neon signs: red lanterns, steam, and plastic awning dripping rain.

E8.name: rooftop
E8.appearance: An old-building rooftop crowded with AC units and water tanks; distant neon skyline, puddles mirroring the lights.

E9.name: subway corridor
E9.appearance: An underground corridor under pale fluorescent tubes, tile walls plastered with faded ads, turnstiles at the far end.

E10.name: rain-alley courier station
E10.appearance: A courier station at the end of a narrow rain alley: tin roof, yellow-lit window, key tags hanging on the wall.

E11.name: brass name mailbox
E11.appearance: A brass mailbox nailed to the station wall, courier name and year engraved on the face, edges already verdigris.

E12.name: spare wax seals
E12.appearance: Three deep-red spare wax seals strung on hemp cord and hung from a night-market stall beam, star patterns carved on the faces.

E13.name: shared e-bike
E13.appearance: A brand-new teal shared e-bike with an ad board in the basket, nothing like the dark-red old motorcycle.

E14.name: Officer Zhou
E14.appearance: A lean city inspector with a full beard, dark-blue uniform raincoat, and peaked cap; build somewhat like Lin's but stockier.

E15.name: string of red lanterns
E15.appearance: A row of five wet red lanterns hanging along the night-market stall awning, tassels dripping rain.

E16.name: brass padlocks
E16.appearance: Two brass padlocks hanging on the station iron gate, shanks faintly glowing, keyholes plugged with rainproof wax.

E17.name: Xiaotao
E17.appearance: A runner girl from the far side of the night market, light-brown hairband and gray-blue rain cape; at a glance somewhat like young Aning, but rounder chin and shy unfamiliar eyes.

E18.name: replica wooden box
E18.appearance: A half-palm replica wooden box shaped much like the wax-sealed wooden box, but without copper corners, sealed with cheap bright-red wax.

E19.name: Buyer Zhou
E19.appearance: A middle-aged man in gold-rimmed glasses and a beige trench coat, left hand carrying a crocodile-pattern case, mild smile with an edge.

E20.name: yellow-plate moped
E20.appearance: An old moped with a yellow plate, raincoats stuffed in the basket; shape near the old motorcycle but definitely not the same one.

features.E1: Lin: woman courier, bright-red hooded raincoat, black mail bag on left shoulder; no chin scar, no ring on right hand.
features.E6: Abao: male rival, same bright-red hooded raincoat, similar build, chin scar, silver ring on right hand.

lookalike_pairs.note: Red-raincoat confuse: when alone, do not draw the other; when co-present, bind scar / ring / mail bag.

scenes.setting: Rooftop pickup (introduce five lanterns · two brass padlocks)
actions: On a rainy night, red-coated courier Lin steps onto the rooftop; puddles mirror the distant neon.

actions.action: A string of red lanterns—five in a row—hangs along the night-market stall awning; Lin looks up and counts them to confirm she has not taken the wrong alley.
Two brass padlocks hang on the rain-alley courier station iron gate; Lin unlocks one with a key.

actions: Lin shakes rain from her hood brim on the rooftop and guards the black mail bag on her left shoulder.
Lin checks the mail-bag liner and confirms the wax-sealed wooden box is still there.

actions.action: The wax-sealed wooden box rests quietly beside the rooftop puddles, its dark-red wax seal intact.

actions: Lin dozes against a water tank; the red raincoat flutters lightly in the wind.
Lin opens the delivery ledger and logs this rooftop job on carbon paper.
Lin writes the buyer's code name and handoff time in the delivery ledger.

actions.action: Buyer Zhou in gold-rimmed glasses briefly appears at the rooftop edge, only nods, then vanishes into the rain.

actions: Lin closes the delivery ledger and tucks it into the mail-bag side pocket.

actions.action: Neon flashes on the copper corners of the wax-sealed wooden box.

scenes.setting: Night market greets the apprentice (introduce three wax seals)
actions: At the dawn night-market stall, Lin greets young Aning arriving on the dark-red old motorcycle.

actions.action: Aning jumps off the old motorcycle and hangs her helmet on the handlebar.
Lin points to the three spare wax seals strung on the beam and teaches Aning to read the star patterns.
Aning crouches by a puddle at the night-market stall, watching steam rise with curious eyes.
Lin explains to Aning which alley signs are coded signals.
Aning looks back at the parked old motorcycle, eyes full of longing.

actions: In the pale subway corridor, red-raincoat Abao glances back from behind the ad wall; the chin scar flashes.
Abao stops before the turnstiles at the corridor end; the silver ring on his right hand taps the rail.
Abao brushes past a street singer in the corridor, defiant look.
Abao carries an empty mail bag through the crowd in the subway corridor.
In the subway corridor, Lin and Abao pass side by side—one with a black mail bag, one with a silver ring.
Lin guards her mail bag on instinct; Abao scoffs lightly and keeps walking.
Abao looks back at Lin; under the tubes their red raincoats are almost the same color.
Lin and Abao split at the corridor fork, each heading the opposite way.
Weeks later on a stormy night, Lin keeps watch alone on the rooftop, the wax-sealed wooden box on her knees.

actions.action: Lin opens the delivery ledger; rain has wrinkled the cover and blurred the writing into stains.

actions: Lin wipes water beads from the copper corners of the wax-sealed wooden box.
Lin leans on the rooftop rail, staring at neon swallowed by the rain curtain.

actions.action: The wax-sealed wooden box mirrors broken lantern light in the puddles.

actions: The rainy season stretches on; day after day Lin climbs the rooftop for handoffs.
Another typhoon night, Lin wraps her red raincoat tight and keeps watch by the water tank.
At Qingming, Lin stands on the rooftop gazing at distant neon still lit.
At high summer noon, Lin wipes AC units baked hot by the sun.
Through autumn rain, the wax seal on the wax-sealed wooden box turns faintly tacky in the damp.
Another New Year's Eve, Lin keeps watch alone on the rooftop until dawn.

scenes.setting: Night-market patrol (recall wax seals · shared e-bike false friend)
actions: At dawn, Lin patrols along the night-market stall; the dark-red old motorcycle is parked beside it.

actions.action: Lin crouches to check the chain tension on the old motorcycle.
Lin walks under the beam; those three spare wax seals still hang in place.
A teal shared e-bike sits before the stall, ad board in the basket—not Lin's old motorcycle.
Lin stands at the night-market stall logging unsigned job numbers from last night.
Lin hangs a soaked rain cape on a bamboo pole at the night-market stall.

scenes.setting: Rainy-night crash (box pried · old motorcycle wrecked)
actions: A sudden downpour; rooftop puddles rise past the ankles and the wax-sealed wooden box nearly floats.
A truck horn screams in the distance; metal scraping echoes from the alley mouth.

actions.action: Abao climbs onto the rooftop and pries open the wax-sealed wooden box with a small knife; the dark-red wax cracks.
At the alley mouth, the dark-red old motorcycle jolts hard through the rain curtain.
A sideswipe topples the old motorcycle; tank dented, wheels twisted.
On the rooftop, Lin lunges at the pried-open wax-sealed wooden box and clamps the lid shut.

scenes.setting: Aftermath (old motorcycle indirect mention · lantern recall)

actions.action: The day after the storm, Lin stands on the rooftop staring at the pried-open wax-sealed wooden box.
Lin brushes cracked wax crumbs on the wax-sealed wooden box with her fingers, face dark.
Beside the rooftop dispatch wall, Lin notes the date of the old motorcycle wreck.
A photo of the old motorcycle hangs on the station wall; Lin gazes at it a long time.
Lin takes one of the five red lanterns from the awning edge and sits alone in the faint glow.
The pried-open wax-sealed wooden box still gapes empty.

scenes.setting: Empty box sealed (third state · replica wooden box false friend)
actions: Weeks later, Lin binds the empty wooden box with cord, ready to seal it as evidence.

actions.action: Lin lifts a replica wooden box from a carton; it looks like the wax-sealed wooden box but has no copper corners.

actions: Lin carefully sweeps wax crumbs into a paper bag and sticks on a seal label.

actions.action: Cord pulled tight, the wax-sealed wooden box becomes empty-sealed, hollow inside.

actions: Lin locks the empty-sealed wax-sealed wooden box into the rooftop iron cabinet and lets out a long breath.

scenes.setting: False friends: yellow-plate moped and city inspector

actions.action: A yellow-plate moped rolls into the night-market stall—nothing like the wrecked old motorcycle.
Bearded Officer Zhou walks into the night-market stall and talks beside Lin; their builds are alike.
Officer Zhou points at the yellow-plate moped and explains the new parking rules to Lin.
The yellow-plate moped is wheeled away; Lin alone at the night-market stall watches it go.

scenes.setting: False friend: Xiaotao who resembles Aning

actions.action: From the far side of the night market comes runner girl Xiaotao with a light-brown hairband; at a glance she looks a bit like young Aning.
Xiaotao practices tying a cable-style mail-bag strap before the stall; Lin shakes her head—she is not Aning after all.

scenes.setting: Weary and injured (long-range brass padlock recall)

actions.action: At dusk half a year later, Lin with a bandaged left arm stands weary at the rain-alley courier station door.

actions: Lin looks up at the station's yellow-lit window, gaze distant.

actions.action: Those two brass padlocks on the station iron gate clink lightly in the rain; Lin pauses to listen.

actions: Lin presses her palm to the station's cold tin wall, as if saying goodbye.

actions.action: By day, adult Aning returns along the rain alley and strides toward the station.

actions: Aning reunites with injured Lin at the station door; they share a brief embrace.

actions.action: Inside the station, Aning takes the empty-sealed box key Lin hands over.
Lin takes off the red raincoat, hangs it on a chair back, and turns into the rain alley—never to appear again.
Lin's red raincoat still hangs on the station chair back; Aning brushes it lightly with her hand.
By the station wall, adult Aning stands before a newly nailed brass name mailbox.
Aning's fingertips trace Lin's name engraved on the brass name mailbox.
Remade Abao arrives from the subway direction; the black iron ring flashes in the rain.

actions: Aning blocks Abao—one in a dark-blue rain cape, one in a red raincoat—facing off at the station door.
Abao leaves with a cold smile; Aning grips the empty-sealed box key.

actions.action: The shot returns to years ago—the youth learning wax seals at the night-market stall appears again.

anchor.phrase: the youth learning wax seals at the night-market stall

actions.action: The opening moment returns—on the rooftop, a still-sealed wooden box is taken out for the first time.

anchor.phrase: the still-sealed wooden box first taken out at the opening

actions.action: Flash back to the subway corridor of that year—a red-raincoat figure with a chin scar and silver ring on the right hand flashes past.

anchor.phrase: the red-raincoat figure with a silver ring in that year's corridor

actions.action: Again the row of five wet red lanterns along the night-market awning rises before the eyes.

anchor.phrase: that row of five red lanterns along the night-market awning

actions.action: Back to the puddled high platform of first meeting; neon mirrors as before.

anchor.phrase: the puddled rooftop of first meeting

scenes.setting: Close (long-range ledger · long-range wax seals · buyer returns)

actions.action: Aning reopens the rain-blurred delivery ledger and climbs onto the rooftop.
By the night-market beam, those three spare wax seals still hang in place.
Buyer Zhou finally appears on the rooftop; Aning sets the empty-sealed wax-sealed wooden box on a crate beside the puddles.
